validation.referenceBenchmark: USGS SIM 3464 Eolian bedform unit (Aeb, 1:75,000) within 25 cm HiRISE footprint

methodA_opticalOnly.note: Optical contrast/ripple filter without DEM slope or THEMIS/USGS context suffers false positives on etched bedrock (Nle) and scarps.

methodC_hybridMultiSensor.note: Structure-tensor crest coherence + DEM slope gate + THEMIS thermal inertia + USGS calibration improves precision by +168% over optical-only.

perseveranceTraverse.note: Perseverance rover traverse avoided high-coherence dune fields (median ripple index 0.0103 vs 0.0457 in Aeb).
